subject: Money
title: Real vs Nominal
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Real vs Nominal.

hook.text: The S&P 500 returned 10% last year. Inflation was 6%. Your real return was 4%. The headline lied.

buildup.text: Nominal figures don't adjust for inflation. Real figures do. The difference is often massive.

discovery.text: Nominal GDP can rise while real GDP falls. A country can look like it's growing while actually shrinking.

twist.text: Banks advertise nominal interest rates. A 5% savings account with 4% inflation earns you just 1% real.

climax.text: Always think in real terms. Nominal numbers are marketing. Real numbers are truth.

quiz.question: If a savings account pays 5% and inflation is 4%, what is the real return?
